failure_summary.description: Calls misplaced or omitted schema fields, search constraints, hierarchy levels, pagination, or canonical values.
Some calls used an endpoint that did not fully match the requested operation or geographic scope.
Some requested outcomes or facets were missing from the call list.

patch.reasoning: The recurring issues are already covered by the skill’s coverage ledger, endpoint-capability matching, schema-based parameter placement, geographic hierarchy, and final audit rules. Adding another general checklist would duplicate existing guidance; some gold-only optional defaults or batching choices are not sufficiently supported to justify overriding the existing schema-grounded rules.
